description: Read and parse a website's robots.txt: user-agent groups with allow/disallow rules, declared sitemaps, and which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...) are blocked from the whole site. Fast (under 2 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call, with card credits (access_key) or x402.

access_key.description: Prepaid credit key (cs_live_...) bought by card at https://www.aypiai.online/credits. Works on every tool; each call deducts its price.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
